state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper compares Iterated Amplification against supervised learning from ground-truth data and reports that amplification solves the tasks effectively with at worst a modest slowdown. The authors state they do not expect amplification to be as fast as supervised learning, so learning almost as quickly counts as achieving their main goal.
title: Amplification nearly matches supervised learning from ground truth on 5 algorithmic tasks
